mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic growth, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when GDP growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns remain positive when unemployment rises.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate alongside low unemployment indicates tight monetary policy, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Returns are positive under these conditions.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts in late-cycle expansion indicate strong demand, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative in late-cycle with high housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production indicates strong supply, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative with positive industrial production growth.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate indicates tight monetary policy, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Returns are positive when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth with low federal funds indicates strong demand, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative under these conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth in early-cycle expansion indicates recovery, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative with employment growth in early-cycle.
